autoPrompt.title: Welcome — getting started guide
autoPrompt.description: A short path to create an account, import trades, read the dashboard, and open the journal.
autoPrompt.hint: You can always find this guide under Help, even if you dismiss this reminder.

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.summary: Trading account, import, dashboard, and journal.

account.title: Create a trading account
account.body:
Open Trading accounts, then create an account (broker, currency, capital).
This is the foundation for linking trades and tracking PnL.
account.alt: Trading accounts page with the create-account form

import.title: Import or enter trades
import.body:
From Trades or the dashboard, import a CSV or enter a trade.
The format guide stays available in the import dialog.
import.alt: Trade import dialog with the format guide

dashboard.title: Read the dashboard
dashboard.body:
The dashboard summarizes your period: PnL, results, and activity.
Adjust the period and account filters as needed.

journal.title: Open the daily journal
journal.body:
The daily journal and day questions help you learn from each session.
Come back to Help whenever you want to resume this guide.

import-trades.title: Import trades
import-trades.summary: CSV, columns, and checks before confirmation.

open-import.title: Open import
open-import.body: From the Trades page, start Import. Pick the target account, then your CSV file.
open-import.alt: Import button on the Trades page

format.title: Check the format
format.body: Use the built-in format guide, fix columns if needed, then confirm the preview.
format.alt: CSV format guide in the import dialog

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: The calendar colors each day by PnL. Move between months to spot streaks.

day-detail.title: Day detail
day-detail.body: Click a day to see related trades and jump into the journal.

api-connections.title: API connections
api-connections.summary: Link a broker to prepare automatic sync.

open-settings.title: Open API connections
open-settings.body:
Go to Settings → Trading, then scroll to the API connections block.
Today only TopStepX is available; more connections may be added later.
open-settings.alt: Settings Trading tab with the API connections block and TopStepX card

credentials.title: Enter your credentials
credentials.body:
Enter the username and API key from your broker (e.g. TopStepX: Settings → API on the platform).
The Documentation API link on the card opens the provider help. Never share your key.
credentials.alt: TopStepX card in API key edit mode

test-connection.title: Test the connection
test-connection.body:
Save, then use Test connection. The badge becomes Configured or Connected depending on the result.
Without a valid connection, trade sync stays unavailable.
test-connection.alt: TopStepX card with Connected badge and Save / Test buttons

sync-account.title: Sync an account
sync-account.body:
On the Trades page (or calendar), select a matching account type (e.g. TopStep), then use Sync once the integration is OK.
API sync can coexist with CSV import; it does not overwrite existing trades.
sync-account.alt: Trades page with a TopStep account and the Sync button
